label: The Human Spirit
tagline: A small room where the inexpressible can sit, undisturbed.
cluster_explainer: The Human-Spirit is the engine at its most restrained — a practitioner-as-quiet-room, judged entirely by what the engine does not do.
demo_highlights: Sphere is the lowest-detail primitive available — the engine offers nothing for the eye to do except be present.
Bass-band coupling reads the body register, the chest, the room tone — the part of a recording that survives transcription.
Film preset honors grain and patience; it does not smooth the silence between two notes, it lets the silence keep its shape.
smooth_factor 0.95 absorbs transients before they become movement — the visual breathes, it never twitches.
Long idle is itself part of the demo: pauses must read as silence, and the engine must not add anything to the room.
